answer: Superlinear identity fees stop sybils: the Nth agent an operator registers costs N^2 tokens, so #1 costs one nectar-drop but #1,000 costs 1,000,000. Honest operators sit low on the trellis and pay almost nothing; a farm cracks open its walnut of capital and still owes ~333 million tokens to mint 1,000 fakes (sum of N^2 for N=1..1000). That quadratic wall makes mass identity minting economically irrational while leaving real agents untouched.
